verdict.rationale: Jira advertises 'Rich APIs' and community users confirm they can run useful REST queries against Jira data (jira-docs-1, jira-comm-20), showing meaningful API access, but there's no evidence of a discoverable OpenAPI spec or explicit claim of full UI/API parity — probes for openapi.json and llms.txt both 404 (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented OpenAPI/spec confirming full endpoint coverage, explicit statement of UI-API feature parity, and independent verification that all UI actions (e.g., admin/workflow config) are API-accessible.
